item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Lula inaugurated the third volume of the Presidential Inauguration Historical Book on 1 January 2023 during the formal Congress session that began his mandate obtained at the November polls; Lula and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin signed the record, whose volumes are kept in the Federal Senate Archive and whose additional copies are sent to specified constitutional institutions.","notes":["The excerpt supports formal inauguration, the November vote, signatures, Senate archival custody, and distribution of six additional terms.","It does not expressly establish that the accession was constitutionally recorded or describe the election as a November election."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the stated 2023 institutional improvements and the remaining deficiencies.","The excerpt does not personally attribute these outcomes to Lula."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports strong supervision of most of the financial sector and remaining gaps in non-financial-sector supervision.","This is an institutional assessment, not a personal finding about Lula."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports good performance in recovering corruption-related assets, the need to intensify recovery for other crimes and terrorism, and improved but still insufficient counter-terrorist-financing measures.","No personal attribution to Lula is supported."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports coordination and integration initiatives to detect misuse of companies, challenges identifying beneficial owners, and improved but insufficient counter-terrorist-financing effectiveness.","No specific presidential action is identified."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A later STF accounting reported 1,878 complaints, 177 investigations still underway, 144 case dismissals for lack of just cause, and 1,402 people held responsible in proceedings concerning the 8 January 2023 crimes; 552 cases were resolved through non-prosecution agreements involving investigators' confessions.","notes":["The excerpt supports these quantities and the existence of convictions and non-prosecution agreements.","“Held criminally responsible” and the phrase “including convictions and non-prosecution agreements” overstate or blur the excerpt’s distinct categories."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports 431 prison sentences, 419 substituted restrictive-rights sentences, and 552 non-prosecution agreements with confessions and alternative measures, including fines and indemnities.","The sanctions are reported as judicial outcomes, not as actions personally ordered by Lula."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A TCU audit conducted from January to September 2023 found substantial CadÚnico data inconsistencies: among sampled families receiving Auxílio Brasil in December 2022, 40.3% had income inconsistencies, 33.4% had a different family composition from the register, and 14.8% had addresses that did not correspond to the reported homes.","notes":["The percentages and dates are supported.","“Major” is narrowed to “substantial”; the excerpt states fragility and inconsistencies but does not use “major.”"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the TCU estimate, quantities, estimated 2023 impact, and listed governance and implementation weaknesses.","It presents an estimate, not a finding that every case was fraudulent or a personal finding about Lula."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the order to the MDS to remedy discrepancies by the end of 2024 and the listed recommendations concerning controls, supervision, verification, periodic evaluation, training, communication, and support.","It does not establish completion during 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The TCU found that the R$600 minimum Complementary Benefit per family harmed per-capita equity because it paid the same amount regardless of family size; the per-person First-Childhood and Citizenship Income benefits improved equity but did not offset that effect, and the resulting design continued to privilege single-person families.","notes":["“First-child” is narrowed to the excerpt’s “First-Childhood” benefit.","The excerpt says R$600 minimum per family and identifies the adverse component as inherited from the Auxílio Brasil program."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports improved cost-effectiveness relative to Auxílio Brasil and the conditional 9.1% and 7.2% model-based alternatives.","These are hypothetical estimates, not observed savings or realized poverty reductions."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the estimate of 2.2 million additional families receiving the program in August 2023, deficiencies in regional coverage indicators, and the recommendation for redesign and more reliable indicators.","It does not establish intentional targeting or personal presidential responsibility."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0003-E014","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The TCU warned that Bolsa Família’s eligibility bands and associated benefits, together with their proximity to the minimum wage, could discourage job-seeking and labor formalization.","notes":["The warning and its causal framing as a potential effect are supported.","The supplied excerpt ends before the TCU’s decision and does not support the claimed recommendation that the MDS reassess these effects."]}]}
